name: us023-idempotent-rerun
description: 023, Phase 13 (contract §7 Z2): a second run over unchanged state under the SAME lifecycle event performs zero writes of every kind, transitions included — Constitution II's zero-churn guarantee extended to the new write kind. The first run recognises the bound story and advances it; the second run's inputs match the recorded run-state exactly (021's own short-circuit, unaffected by this feature), so it issues literally zero requests of any kind — the strongest available proof that created/updated/transitioned/commented/linked/labeled are all zero at once, not a per-kind count that could individually regress. Byte-identical recorded output on both ports.
